capabilities: Create and fill notes from [[title]]>>{content} link syntax
Prepend or append content to existing notes
Add aliases to the new note's frontmatter
Customize trigger characters and enable automatic push on new lines
extras: A demo is referenced but not shown in the text version of the README.
motivation: Built in response to a forum post requesting this capability.
problem: Adding content to a note other than the one you are writing normally requires creating the file and opening or switching to another pane.
summary: Link-syntax plugin that creates a new note (or targets an existing one) and prepends or appends specified content without opening another pane.
